identity.title: [v0.92][WP-18C.02d][112.d] Integrate Layer 8 authority and delivery states into Observatory

values.goal: Present Runtime-owned Layer 8 authority, delivery, refusal, failure, recovery, and redacted correlation state in Observatory without browser authority.
values.required_outcome: The actual Observatory consumes the terminal #270 served protocol and visibly distinguishes delivered, refused, failed, revoked, and recovery outcomes while retaining no private authority material and never treating request acceptance as delivery.
declared_scope: Observatory adapter for the terminal #270 recipient-acknowledgement route
Existing real recipient_ack runtime proof and authentic handler-output artifact handoff stored under issue-local evidence
Literal eight-case real-browser wrapper over actual Observatory assets
authority_boundary: Browser holds no private key and performs no signing, local signature verification, or policy decision
Runtime-provided signed request and acknowledgement may be forwarded only as opaque ephemeral POST input and must never render, log, cache, or persist
Only served redacted response fields may render
Historical e0fd2364 is inspection-only nonpublication reference and must not be replayed as proof
initial_assumptions: Terminal #112/#265/#270 caches and ancestry are preserved and must be revalidated immediately before bind.
The signed request/acknowledgement pair is opaque transient POST input for the browser and is never renderable or persistable.
operator_constraints: Work only in the canonical bound FastWork worktree after fresh design approval
Create the issue-bound implementation goal only after bind and before product edits
Do not touch stale #114 parent preparation or bind #114
Do not mutate #112 worktrees or replay historical e0fd mock evidence
